title: LDHA as a Potential Therapeutic Target for Lactylation Regulation in Spinal Cord Injury: Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis, Experimental Validation, and Drug Prediction.
authors: Zhang, Bobo; Wang, Shenglong; Xu, Wenting; Su, Xiaochen; Zhang, Yulong; Lu, Ziliang; Zhang, Zhan; Zhang, Yingang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脊髓损伤中LDHA介导乳酸化修饰的免疫代谢调控，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Lactate metabolism and its epigenetic modification, lactylation, are emerging regulators in neurological disorders, yet their roles in spinal cord injury (SCI) remain unclear. Here, we mined SCI transcriptomes from GEO and identified 13 differentially expressed lactylation-related genes (DE-LRGs), with lactate dehydrogenase A (LDHA) significantly upregulated. Immune-infiltration analysis linked LDHA to T cells gamma delta, and Mfuzz time-series clustering showed dynamic LDHA upregulation during acute SCI, which was validated in GSE45006. Random forest and ROC analyses supported the diagnostic value of LDHA. PPI and GeneMANIA networks positioned LDHA at the intersection of lactate metabolism and immune regulation. Drug prediction with Enrichr/DSigDB and docking highlighted folic acid and quercetin dihydrate as candidate compounds. GSVA/GSEA indicated LDHA enrichment in immune activation, metabolic regulation, and stress-response pathways. Immunofluorescence in a rat SCI model confirmed sustained LDHA elevation from 1 to 3 days around the lesion. Importantly, Western blot validation (3 days post-injury) demonstrated increased nuclear HIF-1alpha and p-STAT3;Y705 (total STAT3 unchanged) together with elevated CXCL1, IL-6, and CCL2 and the infiltration marker MPO/CD68; these changes were attenuated by LDHA inhibition (FX11) and partially rescued by exogenous lactate, supporting an LDHA --> lactate --> HIF-1alpha/STAT3 --> chemokine/infiltration axis in acute SCI. Collectively, our data identify LDHA as a key lactylation-related regulator in SCI that contributes to pathogenesis via metabolic reprogramming and immune modulation, highlighting its promise as a diagnostic biomarker and therapeutic target.
abstract_zh: 乳酸代谢及其表观遗传修饰——乳酰化（lactylation），是神经系统疾病中的新兴调控因子，但其在脊髓损伤（spinal cord injury, SCI）中的作用仍不清楚。在此，我们从GEO中挖掘了SCI转录组数据，并鉴定出13个差异表达的乳酰化相关基因（DE-LRGs），其中乳酸脱氢酶A（lactate dehydrogenase A, LDHA）显著上调。免疫浸润分析将LDHA与γδ T细胞相关联，Mfuzz时间序列聚类显示LDHA在急性SCI期间动态上调，并在GSE45006中得到了验证。随机森林和ROC分析支持LDHA的诊断价值。PPI和GeneMANIA网络将LDHA定位在乳酸代谢与免疫调控的交汇点。利用Enrichr/DSigDB的药物预测和对接分析突出叶酸和槲皮素二水合物为候选化合物。GSVA/GSEA表明LDHA富集于免疫激活、代谢调控和应激反应通路。在大鼠SCI模型中的免疫荧光实验证实，损伤周围区域LDHA在1至3天内持续升高。重要的是，Western blot验证（损伤后3天）显示核内HIF-1α和p-STAT3;Y705（总STAT3不变）增加，同时CXCL1、IL-6和CCL2以及浸润标志物MPO/CD68升高；这些变化被LDHA抑制（FX11）减弱，并部分被外源性乳酸挽救，支持急性SCI中LDHA → 乳酸 → HIF-1α/STAT3 → 趋化因子/浸润轴的假说。总体而言，我们的数据将LDHA鉴定为SCI中一个关键的乳酰化相关调控因子，通过代谢重编程和免疫调节参与发病机制，并突出其作为诊断生物标志物和治疗靶点的潜力。
